# 00000001583

**IS-13 ★** — source: 38_可积系统与精确可解模型.md

**English.** Conjecture: The rational solutions of Painlevé III(D₈) are generated by Zeilberger-type double recursions, with algebraic generating function (PIII rational generation).

**中文。** 猜想：Painlevé III(D₈)的有理解由 Zeilberger 型双递推生成且生成函数为代数(PIII 有理生成)。
